Name: Em's Flamingo's (Waterside Flamingo's)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A retexture of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36681]GimmeTheZzz Waterside Flamingo's[/url]
Adding a soft pink and salmon colour flamingo, including the baby flamingo and flamingo items
Available for Content Patcher or as separate assets folder

There are two options to adopt the Em's flamingos
You can download [color=#e69138]Em's Flamingos CP[/color], using it as a regular CP mod
Or you can replace the assets folder in the original Waterside Flamingo mod
This file is called [color=#e69138]Em's Flamingo Asset Folder[/color]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Flamingo's CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9XLGGczk/Thank-Yous.png[/img]
﻿
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/GimmeTheZzz?gameId=1303]GimmeTheZzz[/url] for allowing me to make a retexture of their mod
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TJGamerWolf/mods]TjGamerWolf[/url] for commissioning me to work on these
And the community for helping me understand the scripting, you're the best
